name: lti-tools
description: Three LTI 1.3 tools for Moodle on one shared core: LTI Tutor (instructor-designed one-on-one AI tutorials), Persona Chat (persona-based conversations grounded in course materials) and Module Builder (a Word course draft with production notes becomes a Moodle restore file)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp -r src/core/migrations dist/core/migrations && cp -r src/core/web dist/core/web && cp -r src/tutor/migrations dist/tutor/migrations && cp -r src/tutor/web dist/tutor/web && cp -r src/persona/migrations dist/persona/migrations && cp -r src/persona/web dist/persona/web && cp -r src/persona/fixtures dist/persona/fixtures && cp -r src/builder/migrations dist/builder/migrations && cp -r src/builder/web dist/builder/web
